dedupe_keys.name: cn obee beijing household behaviour and electricity

description: The CN-OBEE research team publishes a year of occupant behaviour, thermal conditions and appliance electricity use from one Beijing apartment. Household measurements cover 31 May 2021 to 31 May 2022 at one-minute intervals, with hourly weather from the nearest national station. Variables include occupant presence, indoor conditions, window-opening state and appliance consumption, including split air conditioners. The Figshare collection provides a data ZIP and a PDF code vignette, both free under CC0. These observations can calibrate household behaviour and building-demand simulations with model-energyplus. A caveat is that one family's habits and one apartment cannot represent the full Chinese building stock. Weather-station conditions also differ from the apartment's immediate surroundings. The component labelled Code contains a PDF explanation, not a separate executable software package. No household time series or document was downloaded.
